entry_state: Collateral recovery closes without recognizing the debtor's collateral twice or forgiving the legal claim. Retained option exposure is the difference between separately presented asset and liability. exit_state: The bank chapter closes with separate accounting,regulatory and behavioural assumptions. The insurance opening distinguishes premiums,service revenue,claims,unearned profit and reinsurance. A short-coverage cohort reconciles gross and ceded balances separately;the actuarial triangle gives a point estimate148 while leaving unsupported tail uncertainty unavailable. General measurement and its service/finance transitions follow next.
findings: A proposed funding action,confirmed cash and ambiguous acknowledgement remain distinct;unexpected actual cash must still be recorded with the control violation.
The bank's illustrative14.4% capital ratio is explicitly synthetic and does not establish an applicable Basel or national threshold.
The insurance cohort keeps reinsurance coverage and incurred-claim recovery separate from gross liabilities and exposes the zero counterparty-risk assumption.
The chain-ladder example names conditional-mean,variance and independence assumptions and refuses to infer tail variance from one observation. No new confirmed local defect.
